target.title: feat(cloud): publish content-addressed review snapshots
target.body:
## Summary

- publish complete Gitcrawl cloud-v2 snapshots from one exact source SQLite digest
- stage snapshots without reader cutover when requested, then resume and cut over the same immutable snapshot later
- preserve default reader cutover for existing publish callers
- validate the complete writer and reader contract before any mutation, including `/query`, named queries, and exact argument schemas
- hydrate pull-request files, observation-order metadata, coverage, and immutable snapshot provenance
- scrub private source metadata before publication and pin crawlkit v0.14.0

## Safety

- snapshot IDs equal the lowercase SHA-256 of the source SQLite image
- staged resume requires the exact snapshot capability set, source digest, schema, and coverage
- malformed, stale, partial, or reader-incompatible remote contracts fail before publication or cutover
- the final reader cutover remains gated on crawl-remote snapshot-provenance support

## Validation

- focused CLI and store tests passed
- full GitHub matrix: 10/10 checks passed on `efe13645007ac0f72ecf5cc15715b765b6d6e1cc`
- independent review repaired the missing reader-query preflight
- final local ClawSweeper range review and cross-service staged/resume/cutover proof remain required before merge
